core_obligations: Formulate verifier snapshots and consistency constraints as an SDP.
Use high concentration to certify acceptance in NP.
Construct the matching NP protocol within the measured space-bounded model.
difficulty_reason: Formulates measured logspace quantum proofs as semidefinite programs and uses the high-concentration restriction to obtain a succinct NP certificate, while constructing a matching NP verification protocol. The high-concentration and strong logspace-uniformity requirements are explicit.
